evidence.note: Mahalalel fathers יָרֶד, the pausal form of the name יֶרֶד.
Moses goes down from the mountain. This use establishes the meaning of the verb proposed as the source of the name.

name: יֶרֶד
note: The link to ירד reflects the consonantal spelling. The etymological gloss “descent” is tentative.
summary: Genesis 5:15 names Jared as Mahalalel’s son. His name shares its consonants with יָרַד, “go down,” though the genealogy leaves the connection uncertain.
